description: Definition of a legal or business term as Uzbek law defines it (e.g. MChJ/LLC, charter fund, beneficial owner, apostille, outstaffing, affiliated person), with the article of the act and a page URL to cite. Available in Russian and Uzbek; for other languages the Russian text is returned.

locale.description: Response language: ru, uz or en (default en)

term.description: The term or abbreviation, e.g. "уставный фонд", "MChJ", "апостиль"

name: lookup_term
title: Legal term under Uzbek law
